description: Litecoin mempool depth, fee-rate histogram and a busy/normal verdict. When to use: deciding whether now is a good moment to settle LTC, or how deep the pending backlog is. Do not use: to choose a fee (that is ltc_get_fee_rates). Returns: txs, bytes, usage_mb, max_mempool_mb, load_pct, min_fee_sat_vb, total_fees_ltc, verdict and a fee_rate_histogram.
